# CyberReady+

> CyberReady checks your repository against local rule packs and writes a review pack you can hand to a buyer or auditor—on your machine, without claiming certification.
>
> Not conformity assessment. Not CE marking. Not a notified-body opinion.

## What

Local-first CLI. Rule packs on disk. Review pack for human review. Green gates mean “ready for a human to look,” not “approved.”

## Three ways in

Write (optional pathway interview that suggests checklists → dual drafts → cite-check refuses uncited Claims), Bring existing docs onto pack paths, or CI alone — same local `check`. Human confirms use a TTY or `--i-am-human`. Research briefs never gate pass/fail.

## What not

- Not conformity assessment / CE / notified-body approval
- Not a cloud GRC / regulation chat KB
- Not dependent on Coreward (optional external tutor only)

## Start

- Install: https://github.com/afelin/cyberready#install
- Three ways in / builders: https://afelin.github.io/cyberready/for-builders/
- Pathway (Write depth): https://github.com/afelin/cyberready/blob/main/docs/getting-started/pathway.md
- Authorities: https://afelin.github.io/cyberready/for-authorities/
- White paper: https://afelin.github.io/cyberready/whitepaper/
- Voice: https://github.com/afelin/cyberready/blob/main/docs/voice-and-terms.md
- Assistant contract: https://github.com/afelin/cyberready/blob/main/docs/assistant-loop.md
- ContextPack: `cyberready export --context-pack`
- Thin MCP example: https://github.com/afelin/cyberready/tree/main/examples/mcp
- Pin: `@v0.4.3`

## Optional

Optional separate product (tutor/enforce client): https://afelin.github.io/coreward/ — CyberReady is self-sustaining without it.
